descriptionChirho: To be or become strong, mighty, powerful — Qal stem expressing inherent strength or growing in power.
To be or become numerous, many, great in number or extent — Qal stem expressing abundance or multiplicity.
To break or gnaw bones — Piel intensive stem with a distinct denominative meaning derived from עֶצֶם (bone).
To make strong, to cause to be mighty — Hifil causative stem indicating causing another to become powerful.
